packageRules.description: ADR-0013 pins dependencies, not these. Override ranges in pnpm-workspace.yaml are deliberate (a floor that clears an advisory, bounded below the next major); the lockfile already fixes what installs. Engines are a support floor; pinning them to the latest release fails install (ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE, PR #2). Both are changed by hand.

ADR-1010: TypeScript stays on 6.0.x until the type-aware lint gate supports 7 (typescript-eslint 8.72.1 still declares typescript <6.1.0, checked 2026-11-01). Lift this rule when either of ADR-1010's exit triggers is met.
ADR-1022: @types/node describes the engines floor and CI, both Node 26. Move all three together, by hand.

ADR-1022: CI's node-version is the LTS line (26), not a patch. setup-node resolves it to the latest 26.x on every run, which is how security patches arrive, so a pin would only freeze them (PR #2, closed). 'replace' still proposes the next major, which ADR-1020's next move is decided against.
